This '''OOM command battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], guarding a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Droid was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]], who voices all the battle droids in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]].
